meta.title: Gallery — Moments from Sri Lanka
meta.description: A curated gallery from my private journeys across Sri Lanka: dawn at Sigiriya, leopards in Yala, misty tea highlands, sacred rituals, coasts and village kitchens.

hero.title: Moments from the Island
hero.intro: Glimpses of dawn mist over the central highlands, sacred ritual chants, solitary leopard tracks in Yala, and the unhurried smiles of my traveling companions.
